source_limit: Installed packages report1.1.20 and two available installed headers exactly match that upstream tag. CPP implementation statements refer to official tagged source; no claim of binary-source reproducibility or native fix.

native_cadence.interpretation: Own odometry is dense in simulation source time but much slower/paused in wall time. Stock smoother wall timer therefore cannot be treated as simulation-time rate integration.

current_wiring.route: DWB and behavior requests ->cmd_vel_nav ->velocity_smoother ->cmd_vel_unguarded ->existing final safety gate ->physical cmd_vel

findings.finding: Timer is wall-clock and rate increment uses configured frequency. use_sim_time affects now/timeout; it does not change timer. OPEN_LOOP accumulates its previous output while simulation is paused.
CLOSED_LOOP uses a source-header moving average. The stock consumer does not reject stale feedback. scale_velocities scales Twist differences, not motor wheel slew.

Only the target is clipped; feedback-based acceleration output can exceed target bounds. With current1.397,target0,deceleration3.2/frequency20, output1.237 exceeds the current .8 final-gate request cap.
DWB RotateToGoal acts only inside goal XY tolerance; adding an RPP rotate_to_heading key to DWB will not provide initial path alignment.

Installed RPP supports path/goal rotation at zero translation, angular acceleration and stopping-angle limiting. It still supplies local Twist commands and does not model wheel actuation. It is a separate controller change, not a smoother configuration toggle.

minimal_recommendation.primary: Retain the existing DWB and RL subgoal interface. Complete the separately-owned final sim-time feedback/wheel-coupling correction first; stock CLOSED_LOOP/scale alone is not a sufficient physical bound fix.
minimal_recommendation.why: The final gate may alter smoother output after smoothing, and physical wheel slew couples v/w; neither stock smoother setting addresses that boundary. Further cap reduction without a coupled bound is not causal validation.
minimal_recommendation.optional_local_configuration_candidate: Only after coupled final execution bounds are addressed, CLOSED_LOOP + scale_velocities=true with explicit per-robot relative odom_topic and a declared source-window/feedback-age policy can be evaluated as a separate predeclared change. Keep caps and task criteria unchanged.
minimal_recommendation.configuration_limit: No stock1.1.20 YAML option converts this smoother wall timer to simulation time. A clock-aware implementation change would need separate source binding/tests; do not pretend use_sim_time=true already does so.
minimal_recommendation.rpp_option: Do not switch the current DWB in this repair. RPP rotate-to-heading could be evaluated later as an explicitly versioned local controller alternative; it can reduce large-angle mixed motion, with new collision/progress and tracking behavior to validate.

verification_before_native: Replay held-clock commands with no new odometry: no unbounded command accumulation or source freshness claim.
Check source-time feedback stale/conflict/frame cases and the CLOSED_LOOP above-cap counterexample against the final gate.
Use the independent wheel-slew model for mixed->turn-only, mixed->zero, sign changes, max-speed cases; keep angular1.2 and sampled acceleration7 gates.

If feedback/config changes, version the parameter readback (old fe0a reviewer requires OPEN_LOOP) and verify actual loaded three-robot params including odom_topic/odom_duration/scale_velocities/max_accel/max_decel.
Any later native validation retains actual raw local odometry, dense source sampling, both angular signs, three-robot accepted movement>.05, strict closure and all original task gates.
scope: Read-only local files/installed headers/package versions, primary tagged source retrieval, original-v5 log statistics and independent algebra. No repository edits, ROS calls, new simulator/native launch, controls, training, or gate changes.
